description: This is a PHPUnit test class `PasswordStrengthServiceTest` for the `PasswordStrengthService` in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test cases for validating password policies, enforcement, and related functionalities within the authentication service layer.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the PasswordStrengthService functionalities in OrangeHRM's authentication module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, including instantiating the service under test and setting up the environment with mock services and configuration.

methods.name: testGetEnforcePasswordDao
methods.description: Tests that the getEnforcePasswordDao method returns an instance of EnforcePasswordDao.

methods.name: testCheckPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Tests the password policy validation, ensuring correct messages are returned based on password strength.

methods.name: testIsValidPassword
methods.description: Validates whether a password meets the specified strength criteria.

methods.name: testLogPasswordEnforceRequest
methods.description: Tests logging of password enforce requests, including mocking user retrieval.

methods.name: testValidateUrl
methods.description: Tests the validation of a password reset URL.

methods.name: testGetUserNameByResetCode
methods.description: Tests retrieving a username associated with a password reset code.

methods.name: testSaveEnforcedPassword
methods.description: Tests saving a new enforced password for a user, verifying success or failure based on username validity.
